The transfer is never committed (D9 owns it) and the Transfer screen is scoped by crew only (WEBPET-2139).

A crew piece-out is a PieceOut row with no Employee and no EmployeeSource tag; the importer stores it with a NULL employee and synthesizes no time-in. The two crew-outs are required: with no time-out the day plans 0 job cards. Time-outs carry crew only, like B11 and the device sample.

pieceJob 4204 is ensured on screen (fixtureRowsOnScreen). 4 pieces stays under maximumNumberOfPieces 5; one shared crew-in and crew-out makes every split rule give 2 / 2. dayOffset -17 is B8's own fixture day (0..-16 are taken).

cleanup: the members' cards plus the fixture crew's employee-less cards on the day (crewCodes) are swept before the import, so B8 self-heals a killed run's leftover; the run's five cards are deleted after.
transfer.jobCards counts PIECE-BEARING preview cards: B1 CREW's Exercise Job (4000-General, 10 min) adds one pieceless card per member at the day start, which is crew setup, not the split under test.
